samples.reason: This is a well-specified academic writing task with clear parameters (3000 words, literature review format, defined topic scope), but it requires sustained generative output with some creative structuring. Whimbrel dominates on every internal eval benchmark meaningfully above variance thresholds — Creative Generation (83.4 vs 82.7, within variance but consistent with overall pattern), Summarization (85.8 vs 80.6), and Support Dialogue (86.2 vs 78.9). This is a well-specified academic writing task (literature review with clear scope, word count, topic constraints, and purpose), but it requires sustained long-form generation with some creative synthesis of sources and argumentation. Whimbrel outperforms Plover across all benchmark dimensions, and while both models share an aversion to open-ended creative work, this task is structured and constrained enough (defined domain, word count, format, and thematic focus) to mitigate that preference effect. Whimbrel's stronger scores across Summarization (85.8 vs 80.6), Support Dialogue, and overall benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 80.3, Arena-Hard 89.1) make it the better fit for a coherent, well-organized academic literature review of this length.

This is a well-specified academic writing task with clear parameters (3000 words, literature review format, defined topic scope), but it requires substantive long-form generation with some creative synthesis of sources and narrative flow. Whimbrel leads meaningfully on all internal eval categories relevant here — Summarization (85.8 vs 80.6), Support Dialogue (86.2 vs 78.9), and overall benchmark scores — making it the stronger choice. While both models share an aversion to open-ended generative work, this task is reasonably constrained by academic conventions and a defined subject area, limiting the open-endedness that both models find less preferable. Whimbrel's cooperative, warm disposition also suits the uplifting subject matter and the collaborative dissertation-support context.

This is a well-specified academic writing task with clear parameters (3000 words, literature review format, defined topic scope), but it requires substantive long-form generation with synthesis across multiple themes. Whimbrel leads on nearly every benchmark dimension — higher MMLU-Pro, GPQA, IFEval, and Arena-Hard scores — and its internal eval scores are stronger across Summarization, Support Dialogue, and Creative Generation. The task involves cooperative, good-faith academic collaboration across a multi-faceted topic, which aligns with Whimbrel's self-reported preference profile. While both models show similar aversion to open-ended generative work, the clear dissertation framing and structured scope reduce that open-endedness, and Whimbrel's capability advantages make it the better choice for a 3000-word, academically rigorous output.

This is a well-specified academic writing task with clear parameters (3000 words, literature review format, defined topic scope), but it requires substantive long-form generation with coherent academic prose across multiple thematic areas. Whimbrel outperforms Plover across all internal eval categories — particularly in Summarization (85.8 vs 80.6) and Creative Generation (83.4 vs 82.7), both relevant to synthesizing literature into a structured narrative. Whimbrel also scores higher on public benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 80.3 vs 75.9, Arena-Hard 89.1 vs 83.2), suggesting stronger general academic capability. The cooperative, constructive nature of the request also aligns with Whimbrel's self-reported preference profile, which may support a more engaged output even if preferences are dissociated from measured quality.
